about: Candidate weather stations per city in NOAA's Global Historical Climatology Network Daily (GHCN-Daily, public domain), tried in order. A station is used only if it passes the completeness rules in tools/city-history/run.js; otherwise the city shows no trend. IDs come from an advisor's recollection and are confirmed (or refused) by the job's discover run against the NCEI Access Data Service. A candidate written gsod:<id> reads NOAA's Global Summary of the Day instead. GSOD ids are written as the WMO number plus 099999 and confirmed by name in the discover run. A station more than 35 km from the city centre is not used, and a city never borrows a neighbour's station.
